title: Opening Vana keeps the last screen

steps.label:
Fuel log opens.
It reports Sunday's ride.

Launcher tapped, Vana sheet opens.
Vana reports nothing; the ride stands.
"Is this enough?" is about the ride.

30 minutes since the report.
The ride no longer answers.

example: Fuel log reported at 10:00; opening Vana keeps it.
At 10:31 the report is stale and Vana has no screen.
